statement_en: Suppose $f:[M,+\infty)\to\mathbb{R}$ is integrable as an improper integral, is monotone decreasing to $0$, and $$\int_M^{\infty} f(t)\,dt$$ converges. Then the series $$\sum_{n\geq M} f(n)$$ also converges, and conversely.
callout_body: 如果说被求和函数$f:[M,+\infty)\to\mathbb{R}$可积(或者说广义黎曼积分存在)，并且函数单调减少到0,并且函数的积分$$\int_{M}^{\infty}f(t)\,dt $$是收敛的积分。那么级数$$\sum_{n\geq M}f(n)$$也是收敛的，反之亦然。
